title: Record ordinary solver stops and expose persistent headless report paths
body:
## What and why

Refs #654. Ordinary solver cap, convergence, stability and backend failures now leave a bounded local `solver_error` diagnostic while preserving the original typed error or stopped result. Successful physical transients, malformed parameters and cancellation do not create records.

Reports include command/step, model size, observed progress and available backend context, without a copied model, replay or crash prompt. Context belongs to the actual solve, including children of `solve.run`. Device failures use a typed backend error rather than matching message strings.

Solver records are pruned before recovered panics and other crash reports. If a full crash budget immediately discards a new solver diagnostic, the command returns its original error without announcing a nonexistent path. CLI/headless MCP retain reports in the per-user data directory by default; CI and automated desktop recovery stay isolated. `FIELDCRAFT_CRASH_DIR` can select a mounted worker directory, subject to automation roots. Local stderr prints the actual retained path; automation error/results use the home-redacted display path.

## Validation

Tested revision: `cb89c56114b26c8ab1f6eaaccb5d1e46dba86ffd`, rebased onto `3751d3bb93676aa49d1a18c438424be88162ac03`. Current verification is Linux CPU-only, with `FIELDCRAFT_GPU=cpu`.

- Normal suites and doc tests for all nine touched crates pass: 898 harness passes, zero failures, 41 existing heavy ignores. This includes 21 fluid-device wrappers and one offscreen-device wrapper that returned early under the CPU policy; no GPU numerical execution is claimed.
- Engine: 390 unit and two integration tests pass, including full count/byte crash-budget protection, durable report location, returned-path privacy, typed backend refusal and ordinary embedded-session isolation. CLI seven tests and MCP protocol/workflow suites pass.
- Scoped nine-crate `cargo check` and all-target clippy with `-D warnings`, formatting, diff and tracked-path checks pass. Feature generation from the tested CLI matches the committed page.
- Isolated real CLI and MCP CPU processes deliberately hit a cantilever DOF cap: reports survive process exit in the default per-user location, local stderr names the actual file, returned paths redact home, the original cap failure remains intact, and repeats increment to two.
- No current GPU numerical or native-window run, full workspace gate, heavy suites or oracle run. No solver numerical scheme or shader changed.

## Historical demonstration

The attachments retain their original capture revision. The historical RTX 4090/Vulkan example illustrates diagnostic reporting and cached-device context; it does not verify the updated revision on a GPU.

<!-- fieldcraft-attachments:start -->
### Attached files

These uploads are complete; earlier pending-upload wording below describes the original handoff.

Capture/source revision: `e7b00e713b42c93b574bf279b78d46356975baac`.

**solver-errors-654.mp4**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1f00aa3d-5e4d-4b7a-89c6-18bd54a4a3b4

**solver-record-device.png**

![solver-record-device.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4c7f749b-9d7f-4993-b5d9-43efafd7a353)

**solver-record-path.png**

![solver-record-path.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a18d01d1-5cc1-4175-9522-ee7fe1de31bc)

<!-- fieldcraft-attachments:end -->

The original 64-cell flow intentionally reaches its steady-time cap, then completes a requested physical transient without creating another record. Media remains outside feature history.

## Limits

No current GPU numerical or native-window verification was available. Backend changes here concern error typing and diagnostic observations; no shader or numerical scheme changed. Confined sessions need a granted report directory; persistence failure leaves the original solve outcome unchanged. Container workers still need a persistent mount to retain files after the container is removed.

reviews.author: jyviko
reviews.body:
Thanks for this, recording ordinary solver stops will make support much easier! One thing has to change before it can go in, plus a conflict with develop:

- **Solver records evict real crash reports.** They share the crash folder's budget (20 reports, 100 MB), and `prune` in `crash.rs` evicts recovered panics first, then the oldest. With up to 5 records per process, a few sessions of ordinary non-convergence push out crash reports that hold the user's design and replay. Please prune `solver_error` records first, or give them their own cap or subfolder.
- **Persistence:** CLI and MCP write to `$TMPDIR/fieldcraft-automation/crashes`, so they persist only with `FIELDCRAFT_CRASH_DIR`. Please adjust the title or the default.
- **Privacy nit:** the absolute report path in the MCP error and in `diagnostic_report` (`solver_diagnostic.rs`, `finish`) isn't redacted, so it can carry the username.
- **Nit:** GPU failures are detected by matching `"GPU:"` strings in `solver_failure`. A typed variant would hold up better.
- **Conflict:** it now conflicts with develop, so please rebase.
